## 1. Professional Positioning & Thesis

"AI systems should retain context, adapt over time, and remain useful beyond a single interaction."

Twelve years building scalable platforms — now focused on applied AI systems architecture: agent orchestration, cognitive memory, RAG pipelines, and generative UI. Foundation models taken out of the chat box and into persistent, autonomous products that run in production.

### Verifiable Proof Metrics
- 12+ Years shipping software: distributed delivery platforms, cloud data pipelines, enterprise integrations.
- Production B2G AI platform live: Strata serves municipal profiles in Brazil including Porto Alegre/RS.
- 2.8M ops/s State-fork allocation: multiverse-js benchmarked at 430ns per fork; LWW merge at 44.9K ops/s inside 60fps frame budget.
- +50pp Typed memory vs flat retrieval: Blind validation (N=200, p < 10⁻⁷) under EPCG Memory Access Model; external AMA-Bench pilots at 72.5% vs BM25 70.0% and LongContext 50.0%.

## 2. Production Systems & Open Source

### Strata (Hub Esfera · Production B2G)
- URL: https://jorgeguberte.com/systems/strata
- Status: Live in production serving Brazilian city profiles (including Porto Alegre/RS).
- Architecture:
  - Multi-source public-data ingestion (BigQuery, PNCP, FNDE, INEP) transformed via data-flywheel pipelines into Parquet snapshots and agent-optimized Markdown.
  - Embedded DuckDB analytical layer for ultra-low-latency in-memory SQL execution.
  - Deterministic LangGraph agent with skill-based reasoning and sandboxed read-only tools.
  - Full observability via LangSmith across education, procurement, and budget domains.
  - Multi-tenant enterprise deployment on Cloud Run with Cloud SQL and Clerk RBAC.

### Multiverse (multiverse-js · Open Source)
- URL: https://jorgeguberte.com/systems/multiverse
- GitHub: https://github.com/jorgeguberte/multiverse
- Package: npm install multiverse
- License: MIT
- Status: Open source · benchmarked.
- Architecture:
  - Solves the Single-Timeline State Paradox in modern UI and multi-agent workflows.
  - Git-style branching semantics for synchronous state: fork application state, explore alternate timelines, merge what works.
  - Proxy lazy-evaluation with a CRDT-lite patch engine.
  - Benchmarks: Fork allocation at 2.8M ops/s (430ns) — 118,000x mutation cost ratio; Last-Write-Wins (LWW) merge optimized to 44.9K ops/s (26µs) inside 60fps window.

### Pixie (Embodied AI · Real-time Voice)
- URL: https://jorgeguberte.com/systems/pixie
- Status: Active R&D / Flagship embodied system.
- Architecture:
  - Real-time bidirectional voice streaming over Gemini Live API WebSockets (16kHz / 24kHz PCM).
  - Physics-based locomotion with Rapier.
  - Synchronous spatial tool execution in 3D WebGL / Three.js environment.
  - Audio-amplitude-driven lip-sync without precomputed visemes.
  - Observer mode building pointer heatmaps for context-aware spatial commentary.
  - Neurodivergent-first interaction constraints: predictability, calm pacing, sensory gating.

### Ayvu-Talian (Low-Resource NLP · Open Source)
- URL: https://github.com/jorgeguberte/ayvu-talian-base
- Status: Open source transformer from scratch.
- Architecture:
  - 5.39M-parameter decoder-only transformer trained from scratch for Talian (Venetian minority language spoken in southern Brazil).
  - Complete pipeline owned end-to-end: corpus curation, custom tokenizer accommodating Portuguese code-switching and non-standardized orthography, PyTorch training, and inference.

## 3. The Lab (Applied Research Programs)

### EPCG (Emergent Personal Cognitive Graphs)
- URL: https://jorgeguberte.com/lab/epcg
- Status: Empirically validated memory access model · external pilots on AMA-Bench.
- Key Scientific Contribution:
  - Falsified flat top-k vector retrieval (`retrieve(query) -> top-k`) as an adequate interface for agent memory.
  - Memory Access Model v0: Decomposes memory access into four typed operations:
    1. EpisodicAt(turn): discrete episodic event lookup.
    2. StateAt(entity, dimension, T): point-in-time state validity.
    3. StateHistory(entity, dimension, range): temporal state transitions.
    4. SemanticRetrieve(query): open discovery.
  - Blind validation: N=200 tasks across two domains; flat retrieval scored 19.5% vs 70.0% for typed access (+50.5 percentage points, p < 10⁻⁷) without LLM confounding.
  - External AMA-Bench pilots: EPCG-T achieved 72.5% vs BM25 70.0% and LongContext 50.0%.
  - Mathematical formalization: Category-theoretic composition (categorical layers, functorial bridges, monadic orchestration core).

### LoomDB (Temporal Memory Engine)
- URL: https://jorgeguberte.com/lab/loomdb
- Status: Active research · Rust core compiled to WASM · paper in draft.
- Core Architecture:
  - Models memory as a nonlinear dissipative dynamical system over a mutable directed graph.
  - Asymptotic saturation: a_v(t+1) = a_v(t) + (1 - a_v(t)) * alpha; energy remains mathematically bounded under infinite stimulation cycles.
  - Lazy decay modulated by consolidated stability: reinforced traces resist forgetting; neglected memories fade sublinearly.
  - Sub-stochastic propagation: outgoing transition weights sum to <= 1.0, guaranteeing global bounded signal.
  - Evolutionary policy optimization: routing between semantic similarity and graph activation energy is determined by an evolvable program over query features.

### Y2K Sensory (Cognitive Accessibility & Visual Maximalism)
- URL: https://jorgeguberte.com/lab/y2k-sensory
- Interactive Lab: https://jorgeguberte.com/labs/y2k-sensory/
- Status: Public experiment.
- Architecture:
  - Dual-layer CSS architecture separating decorative animation from functional UI elements.
  - AttentionGuard presets tailoring contrast, motion density, and sensory triggers for ADHD and autistic users.
